sections.markdown:
## B — Audience, level and prerequisites: two-way left turn lanes and METRO light rail safety
Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, including Phoenix-area drivers who will share streets with METRO light rail.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the two-way left turn lane is common on two-way streets and has strict limits on its use [A01], and light rail trains are quiet and run beside car traffic, so the crossing and turning rules prevent crashes [A02].
Level: practical recall of center-lane rules, track crossing rules and how to tell an approaching train from a departing one.
Prerequisites: the lane-line and turning pages that precede this section.
